title: How to Help Simplify and Accelerate Identity Recovery | Blog | Commvault
summary: Identity recovery can be complex and highly manual. Learn how automation, orchestration, and unified workflows can help support faster, more trusted restoration.
body_markdown:
## Identity Recovery Best Practices


Start by documenting the identity systems that support critical operations and the dependencies between them. Define recovery roles so security, identity, infrastructure, and continuity teams understand who makes decisions and who performs each part of the process.


Next, help reduce avoidable manual work. Identify recovery activities that can be automated or orchestrated, especially steps that must be performed in a specific order. Use centralized workflows where possible to help give teams a consistent view of recovery across hybrid identity environments.


Finally, make trusted restoration the objective. Recovery is not complete simply because a service is available again. Teams need a process that helps them return identity systems to a trusted state while minimizing the risk of restoring unwanted changes. Review the recovery approach regularly so it continues to reflect the identity environment and business priorities.


The broader lesson is straightforward: Simpler identity recovery comes from preparation, coordinated workflows, and fewer manual dependencies. Together, these practices can help teams recover more efficiently and minimize downtime after an attack or disruption.
